name: Sabha
description: Connect OpenClaw to a Sabha chat server

sabha.label: Sabha
sabha.description: Connect to a Sabha chat server via WebSocket.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Sabha channel.

baseUrl.description: Sabha server URL (site root) including workspace ID for multi-tenant (e.g. https://sabha.co/1000006). The setup wizard hits {baseUrl}/skill to verify the URL points at a Sabha server.

apiBaseUrl.description: Bot API base URL (e.g. https://sabha.co/1000006/api/bots). Auto-populated from the registration response; bearer-auth HTTP calls go here.

botKey.description: Bot key from registration via join code (e.g. 42-AbCdEfGhIjKl).

botName.description: Bot display name shown to users in typing indicators.

websocketUrl.description: WebSocket URL (auto-detected from registration). Override only if needed.

typingEnabled.description: Show 'Bot is typing...' while processing (WebSocket mode only).

dmPolicy.description: Who can send direct messages to the bot.

allowFrom.description: User IDs allowed to DM (allowlist mode only).

allowPrivateAttachmentHosts.description: Dangerous — disables SSRF protection on attachment downloads. Only enable in corporate / split-horizon DNS setups.

replyToMode.description: Threading mode. 'off' = inline replies; 'first' = thread on first reply; 'all' = always thread.

rooms.description: Per-room overrides keyed by room id. Used for per-room system prompts.

accounts.description: Named bot accounts layered over the base config for multi-bot setups.

defaultAccount.description: Bot account id used when no explicit account is passed. Defaults to the alphabetic-first entry.
